purpose: Preserve current InKCre mark and package native vector assets; no redesign.

sources.role: Standard geometry master, 256 viewBox. Used at logical sizes 48 and above in this pack.
Existing 32-viewBox small-size geometry, shared by design system and current web app. Used at logical sizes up to 32 in this pack.
Corroborating current website logo; not the rendering master because its connector path differs from UI source line encoding.

additional_evidence.finding: Current UI design-system logo points to src/logo.svg.
Current visual language describes a neutral black/white/gray framework, rectilinear shapes and a flat appearance.
Swift app includes light and dark/tinted raster versions of the same mark. Inspected for corroboration only, not traced or used as source.

excluded_reference.reason: Current extension still contains a traced-looking 200px asset with near-white rounded background, off-black tones and a detached gray speck; also identical to asset in archived client-webext. Excluded in favor of clean native web/UI sources. Not a claim that the extension stopped using it.

derived_changes: Preserve all source foreground coordinates, connector strokes and viewBox proportions.
Replace white nested-square knockout with a true even-odd transparent counter.
Provide original black/gray, reverse white/gray, solid black and solid white colorways.
Provide transparent canvases plus four contrasting white/black background combinations.
Select existing 32 geometry for logical sizes <=32 and existing 256 geometry for >=48. This threshold is a pack convention, not an independently verified official brand rule.
Retina exports select geometry by logical display size, not physical raster size.
